verdict.rationale: Reader is a pure HTTP API you can drive non-interactively with curl and request headers such as x-wait-for-selector, x-engine and x-respond-with, which suits scripts and CI jobs. A prebuilt GHCR container bundling headless Chrome lets you self-host it in automated pipelines, and the API key is passed as a header, which works with CI secrets. missing for 10: explicit CI-specific docs or examples (e.g. a GitHub Actions recipe), independent hands-on corroboration of CI/headless use.
